body:
## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `036dfe5894bb63aca0c02ad2d7bee1d134fef4fe`
Local-runs: none

Reviewed read-only against the ruling `6097061442` on #22653 (letter B), the claim `6097687912`, the dev report `6097969764`, PR #22685's body, file list and net diff against `main` at `243dd3c625` (2 files, +655/-158: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` +21/-6, `scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs` +634/-152), and the check-runs on this head. Nothing was built, run or re-run locally; the base and head copies of both files were read out of the shared checkout at their shas.

### ① Derived judgments

**The ruling, clause by clause against the diff.**

- *"When a leg's aggregate result is `cancelled` and at least one shard attested, `judge()` reads the cancelled jobs' check-run annotations through the reader PR #22666 landed."* RIGHT. `shardsNeedingCancelCause(legs, present)` replaces `legsNeedingCancelCause`; its matrix arm (`leg.total` above 1) asks about every shard of the leg with no credential when `attestedAny(leg)` holds, keyed by attestation id. `readCancelCauses()` keeps the one attempt-jobs GET (`/actions/runs/RUN/attempts/N/jobs`, paged) and adds one annotations GET per asked shard; `classifyCancelAnnotations` is reused unchanged (no hunk touches it). The question `--verify` asks and the question `judge()` decides are the same function, as before.
- *"Superseded by a higher-priority request, pass, as #3668 passes a whole-matrix supersession."* RIGHT. In `judge()`, when every asked shard of a leg reads `superseded`, the leg logs `satisfied (cancelled AFTER n of N declared shard(s) attested, and every unattested shard's own check run records a supersession ...)`, lists each shard with its own quoted cause, and `continue`s past the count exactly as the zero-attestation #3668 branch does. The foreign-credential loop after the per-leg loop still runs on this path (`allowed` is filled before the `asked` branch), so a credential from another run or an inconsistent payload still reds a superseded partial; the self-test pins that (`belongs to run 1234`).
- *"Killed by its own timeout, red, naming the shard."* RIGHT. A `timeout` cause goes into `killedShards`; the leg falls through to the count; the roster listing prints `- test-2-of-6  MISSING — killed by its own job timeout ("...")` and the error names the shard twice: in the `published no positive attestation (test-2-of-6)` group and in the appended `Only a recorded supersession excuses a missing shard here (#22653): test-2-of-6: killed by its own job timeout (...)`.
- *"Unreadable, or any other cause (a manual cancel included), red."* RIGHT. `causeOf(id)` defaults to `unreadable` when the map has no entry (or no map at all); `other` reads as `cancel cause not a recorded supersession (...)`. Every failure in `readCancelCauses()` is an `unreadable` cause: no token, no run id, unreadable attempt, a refused or non-array jobs list, no readable display name, zero or several jobs under the expanded name, a job the API reads as anything but `cancelled` (a lost credential is never excused), a refused or non-array annotations read. One shard's failure is that shard's alone; its siblings are still read. Fails closed on every path examined.
- *"Both gates."* RIGHT. `judge()` is gate-agnostic; the dogfood matrix (total 3) qualifies by the same arm, and the single-leg arm for `dogfood-verify` is the old predicate verbatim (`!attestedAny(leg)` and a sibling leg attested). The static guard `scanWorkflow()` now takes `causeLegs = legs.filter(total above 1, or more than one leg)`, which covers `test-gate` (one matrix leg) and both legs of `dogfood-gate`.
- *"The `Test Core` aggregate job gains `actions: read` and `checks: read`, read-only."* RIGHT, and the ci.yml diff is exactly two hunks, both inside `test-gate` (base lines 1355 to 1372 and 1382 to 1396; the job spans base lines 1303 to 1526): the `permissions` block gains the two read scopes under a comment saying what they pay for, the download step's comment is reworded to say those scopes are not for the download, and the `Verify test shard results` step's `env` gains `GITHUB_TOKEN` set from `github.token` under a comment. The job-key list, the job `name:` list and the step `name:` list of base and head ci.yml compare equal, so nothing is renamed; `dogfood-gate` (base line 2183 onward) is untouched.
- *"#16157's ruling is amended, not reversed: a shard killed mid-suite never turns the required check green."* RIGHT. An own-timeout partial is red naming the shard; a partial with no cause read at all is red with #16157's own sentence (the self-test's #16157 battery passes no `cancelCauses` and asserts exactly this). A declared `failure` still adds its own error whatever the causes say, and `shardsNeedingCancelCause` asks nothing for any result other than `cancelled`.
- *"A GitHub wording change degrades to that ruling's reading (red), never to a false green."* RIGHT. `classifyCancelAnnotations` is unchanged; an unrecognised message is `other`, which is red.
- *"Not extended: the whole-matrix-cancelled path with zero attestations keeps #3668's count-based pass without a cause read."* RIGHT. The matrix arm requires `attestedAny(leg)`, so a zero-credential matrix is never asked; `judge()` reaches the unchanged `satisfied (cancelled — run-lifecycle state, #3668; expected attestations: 0)` line; `readCancelCauses()` returns before any request when nothing is asked, so `test-gate` makes no API call on that path and needs no token there. The PR's acceptance note records the residual the ruling names (an all-shards-own-timeout matrix with nothing attested still passes), as the ruling said it should: an acceptance note, not a build.
- *#22606's single-leg semantics.* UNCHANGED where it matters. The single-leg predicate is the old one; the per-leg log line and both single-leg error sentences are byte-identical (the `leg.total === 1` branches keep the old strings). One precision on the dev's "byte-identical" claim: the gate's closing summary line on a superseded single leg now carries an appended sentence (`1 unattested shard(s) were cancelled by a recorded supersession (#3668, #22653)`). That is a log line, not an error; `scripts/pm/ci-failure.mjs` (line 554) parses only the `published no positive attestation (IDS)` error shape, which every red here still carries first in its sentence. No verdict effect.

**Accept-set change.** Inputs red before and green now: a `cancelled` matrix leg with at least one own credential whose every unattested shard records a supersession, on either gate (the measured runs 38036705318 and 38044009552 in the PR body). Inputs still red: own-timeout (named), manual or other cause, unreadable on every path above, and any `failure`. Inputs green before and red now: none in `judge()`. The only new red anywhere is the static guard, which now holds `test-gate` to the two read scopes, the token in its `--verify` step and a `name:` template whose only expression is the matrix shard, expanding from text exactly as from parsed YAML for every shard; the head ci.yml satisfies all of it (the self-test asserts the checked-in baseline is clean with `test-gate` counted as a gate). No unexpected flip found.

**Public surface.** `legsNeedingCancelCause` is removed and `shardsNeedingCancelCause` and `expandMatrixShardName` added; `workflowJobDisplayName` gains an optional third parameter and keeps its old answers when it is absent. The module's other importers at this head (`check-platform-checklist-watchdog.mjs`, `check-required-contexts.mjs`, `check-stall-guard-budget.mjs`) import only `commandWords`, `invokes` and `shellCommands`, so none is affected. No published package is touched.

**Gates on this head** (check-runs read at 2026-10-10T13:36Z, 37 check-runs). Completed `success`: `Dogfood Regression Gate` (the aggregate, so the new `--verify` has run once live on a full roster), all three dogfood shards, `Dogfood Verify CLI`, all six `Test Core (k/6)` shards, `TypeScript Type Check` and its four lanes, `Build Core`, `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Console Pin Gate`, `Build Docs`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, `Check Documentation Links`, `filter`, and the four card-and-claim guards. In progress, not waited for: `Test Core` (the aggregate: the new `--verify` is running live on this run's full test roster) and `Lint & Repo Gates` (it carries `pnpm check:shard-attestation`, which is the 290-assertion self-test and the static guard). No check-run on this head has concluded `failure`. The seat reads CI convergence separately before landing.

### ② Semver level

Matches. The diff touches no `packages/**` path and publishes nothing from any released package; the PR carries `skip-changeset` and no `.changeset/*.md`, which is what that label is for. The PR body's second line is `Clause-②: yes`, verbatim the ruling's and the claim's; a bare `yes` is the widening value by the repo's own fixture naming in `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs`, so no arm is owed. `Check Changeset` concluded `success` on this head.

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions`: empty. Every flag the dev raised, answered:

1. `dogfood-gate`'s permissions and token comments now under-describe their use (they name only the single-leg question). Accepted as an acceptance note, not escalated: prose inside a job the claim forbade touching, neither a defect, a contract violation nor an authoring trap under Prime Directive #10; the suggested wording in the PR body is for the next PR that touches that job.
2. A real job `GITHUB_TOKEN` performing the two reads from `test-gate` is NOT MEASURED. Accepted: the grants are the documented ones for the two endpoints and are the same two `dogfood-gate` has carried since PR #22666; a refusal reads `unreadable`, which is red, so the worst case is today's reading and never a false green. The replays in the PR body prove endpoints, shapes and verdicts under proxy credentials, as stated.
3. The gate-only re-run edge (whether `attempts/N/jobs` lists shards not re-run on that attempt) is NOT MEASURED and carried from #22666. Accepted: a shard absent from the list is `unreadable` for itself alone and the gate reds.
4. The gate runner was re-spelled as a literal script after a harness refusal; 53 of 57 derived commands exit 0, 4 exit 3 NOT MEASURED for want of a built `dist/` (this diff touches no package; `Build Core` is green on the head), `--ran` reconciles 57 of 57. Accepted.
5. Commit trailer and PR footer follow AGENTS.md's model-free form over the harness reminder. Correct precedence; not a review matter.
6. `Clause-②: yes` with no arm, where PR #22666 carried `no (narrowing)`. Judged in ② above: matches the ruling.
7. GitHub reads beyond the card were all GETs; the worktree was removed after the PR opened; the report was posted through `post-stamped.mjs`. No concern.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-22653-partial-cancel-cause`
Reviewed-by: `session_01Q7Fy4uVkvBWgj9CLihdATJ`

**VERDICT: PASS**
